title: You’re not empty.
paragraphs:
Not all silence from God is abandonment.
Sometimes… it’s distance.

You didn’t lose the fire overnight.
It dimmed—slow compromises, quiet distractions, prayers skipped, Word unopened.

And here’s the dangerous part—
drift feels harmless… until you look up and don’t recognize who you’ve become.
“Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you.” (James 4:8)

That means if He feels far…
check the direction of your steps.

This isn’t about shame.
This is about awakening.

The same Peter who denied Jesus stood restored on the shore.
The same David who fell hard wrote psalms again.
The same you who drifted… can return.

No dramatic speech needed.
No perfect words.

One prayer.
One moment of honesty.
One surrender.
And grace will meet you there.
And Jesus is still calling your name.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
